messages.content: i want to know about redstone circuit

In Minecraft, a redstone circuit is a build that primarily focuses on dealing with logic and redstone signals using redstone. Circuits can be used to transmit redstone signals, perform operations with logic gates, store information, shorten and lengthen redstone signals, make redstone clocks, and more. A useful distinction can be made between a circuit performing operations on signals (generating, modifying, combining, etc.), and a mechanism using the environment (moving blocks, opening doors, changing the light level, producing sound, etc).

Higher enchantments decrease the waiting time to return. Four quartz blocks generate naturally as part of each bridge in the bastion remnant.
please what is le tricolore
It is the French national flag in item form, and has no in-game use. Le tricolore is a joke item exclusive to Java Edition 23w13a_or_b.
what should i know about oak log

In Minecraft, a log or stem is a naturally occurring block found in trees or huge fungi, primarily used as a building block and to create planks, a versatile crafting ingredient. There are currently ten types of logs: oak, spruce, birch, jungle, acacia, dark oak, mangrove, cherry, pale oak and poplar; and two types of stems: crimson and warped.
what are desert temple

The desert pyramid contains four loot chests hidden under the floor in the center, which are protected by a TNT trap, and a secret buried room to the side where archaeology can be performed by brushing the generated suspicious sand with a brush. A desert pyramid or desert temple is an uncommon above ground structure found in desert biomes built mostly of sandstone and terracotta.
crafting
In Minecraft, crafting is the process of constructing tools, items, and blocks in Minecraft that can be performed via the inventory, a crafting table, or automatically using a crafter.
how to obtain chiseled copper in minecraft
Waxed chiseled copper and waxed oxidized chiseled copper can be found in trial chambers.
please how is beacon crafted
In Minecraft, a beacon is made from five glass blocks, three obsidian blocks, and one nether star. Place it on a pyramid of iron, gold, diamond, emerald, or netherite blocks to activate its powers.
please how is copper ore used
Copper ore does not oxidize like its block counterparts, despite the ore's texture showing some oxidation. The primary usage of copper ore is to mine it for raw copper.
where does dried ghast come from
In Minecraft, dried ghasts naturally generate in soul sand valleys as part of Nether fossils and have a 1⁄3 (~33.3%) chance of spawning next to one.
please where do i find carved pumpkin
Carved pumpkins generate in rail rooms in woodland mansions, as well as in pillager outposts as a part of scarecrows.
please tell me about nether

In Minecraft, the Nether is a dangerous, volcanic, fungal dimension that resembles a hellish underworld. It contains fire that burns forever; vast oceans of lava; Nether fungi and normal mushrooms in place of plants; many unique mobs, mostly hostile in nature; and exclusive structures, resources, and biomes.
what's tool
A tool is an item used by the player while held to perform actions faster and more efficiently, to gather materials not obtainable by hand, or to perform completely new actions.
give me information about scoreboard

The scoreboard system is a complex gameplay mechanic utilized through commands. Mainly intended for mapmakers and server operators, scoreboards are used to track, set, and list the scores of entities in a myriad of different ways.
what's character

In Minecraft, the term character refers to mobs, skins, personas, and other entities that have an official character name or title, including the official mascot characters. The following list of titles are in order of release.
what's dead bush
In Minecraft, a dead bush is a non-solid plant block found in deserts, badlands, swamps, and old growth taigas. It can only be obtained with shears, and otherwise drops sticks when broken.
tell me about blaze rod
In Minecraft, a blaze rod is an item obtained by killing blazes. It is required to craft brewing stands and blaze powder, which is required to fuel brewing stands and craft eyes of ender.
please what are chainmail chestplate

It is the fourth-highest tier of chestplate, having the same armor points as a golden chestplate but with higher durability. A chainmail chestplate is an uncommon variant of chestplate that cannot be crafted, and is only obtainable through other means such as trading.
can nether portal be crafted

The frame must be at least two blocks wide and three blocks tall. Build a rectangular frame of at least ten obsidian blocks, with corners optional, then light the inside with flint and steel or a fire charge.
what is iron helmet

In Minecraft, an iron helmet is a variant of helmet that is crafted from iron ingots. It is the fifth-highest tier of helmet, having the same armor points as a copper helmet but with higher durability.
please what's best way to mine
In Minecraft, bring torches, food, a pickaxe, blocks, and a water bucket. Mine in a safe pattern, avoid digging straight down, and place torches to prevent mob spawns. Watch for lava and gravel.
please define statistics
Statistics is a game feature that allows players to track certain tasks in the form of numerical data.
please where does minecart come from

Once placed, minecarts can be retrieved by attacking them for some time. One attack from a pickaxe, sword, or axe is enough for a minecart to drop in item form, provided the player's attack cooldown is reset.‌[Java Edition only] A minecart is also destroyed if it makes contact with a cactus, or if shot with a bow/crossbow. Critical hits are not applied to minecarts, although the particles suggest otherwise.
how do i get iron helmet in minecraft
Two armor stands are found in each taiga village outdoor armory, one of them equipped with an iron helmet.
give me information about crying obsidian

Purple particles drip from its faces. Crying obsidian is a luminous variant of obsidian that can be used to craft respawn anchors. Like obsidian, It has high hardness and blast resistance, making it immune to normal explosions.
please what can i use wool for

Unlike stained glass and terracotta, the white variant serves as the undyed block. Wool comes in sixteen colors, which are white, light gray, gray, black, brown, red, orange, yellow, lime, green, cyan, light blue, blue, purple, magenta, and pink. Wool of any color can be re-dyed into any other color.
where do i get glowstone
Glowstone is found on the ceiling of the Nether. Break glowstone blocks to get glowstone dust, which is used for potions and other recipes.
please what witch used for

The witch throws a splash potion of Slowness if the target is eight, nine or ten blocks away and does not already have the Slowness effect. This makes it harder for the player or mob to escape if they attempt to. The witch throws a splash potion of Poison if the target's health is at least 8HP and is not already poisoned.
please what does dragon egg do
The dragon egg, if there is no block below it, falls until it lands on the next available block. When it is being affected by gravity and falling, it exhibits a smooth falling animation.
hey ultron, what is azure bluet used for

Like other flowers, azure bluets can be used as decoration and planted on grass blocks, dirt, coarse dirt, rooted dirt, farmland, podzol, mycelium, moss blocks, mud, or muddy mangrove roots. Azure bluets can also be placed in flower pots.
what is how to tame a cat used for
Tame a cat by giving it raw cod or salmon until hearts appear. Cats scare creepers and phantoms. They also bring you gifts such as string and rabbit hide.
how to create bed
In Minecraft, place three wool in a row above three planks at a crafting table. A bed lets you sleep through the night and sets your respawn point.
how can i get wooden button
In Minecraft, jungle buttons generate naturally on house walls in desert villages. Oak buttons generate naturally in trial chambers making up the various dispensers.
how is how long do dropped items last used
Dropped items normally despawn after five minutes.
please where does obsidian come from
Mine it with a diamond or netherite pickaxe. Obsidian forms when flowing water touches lava source blocks. It is also found in ruined portals and other structures.
how to find cobweb

Cobwebs generate naturally in mineshafts, stronghold libraries, igloo basements, abandoned villages, woodland mansion spider spawner rooms, trial chambers around specific trial spawners and abandoned camps.
please what exactly is villager
Villagers are humanoid passive mobs that inhabit villages, work at their professions, breed, and interact with each other.
please i want to know about woodland mansion

It is often found far away from the world spawn point. A woodland mansion is a massive procedurally-generated structure found in dark forests and pale gardens. A mansion is inhabited by vindicators, evokers, and imprisoned allays, and is one of the only places where totems of undying can be obtained.
why use ender dragon

In Minecraft, by using the F3 + B shortcut, the dragon's bounding box appears.‌[Java Edition only] However, it cannot be damaged at just any spot in this large volume: eight green sub-hitboxes are also shown, which indicate the locations where the dragon can take damage: the tail (three hitboxes), body, head, neck, and right and left wings. Name tags cannot be used on an ender dragon, because it is not possible to interact directly with it, only with its parts (green hitboxes), which are not living entities. An ender dragon killed by /kill‌[Java Edition only] or from damage belonging to the type self_destruct, and not spawned from the player‌[Bedrock Edition only], skips its death animation and the exit portal immediately opens; in Bedrock Edition, if the dragon was killed by /kill it remains in the same place and plays its death animation there instead of flying to the exit portal.
what baked potato brick slab
A baked potato brick slab is a baked potato brick variant of a slab, exclusive to 24w14potato.
what exactly is chorus plant
Chorus plants are blocks that naturally generate on the outer islands of the End.
where can i find breach

Breach can be obtained through an enchanting table by enchanting a mace or a book, or by trading with a librarian of any level,​[until: Villager Trade Rebalance] or from fishing. Its enchanted book form can also be found from ominous vaults, as well as any other structures that generate enchanted books.
please what is poisonous potato chips good for

In Minecraft, to eat poisonous potato chips, press and hold use while it is selected in the hotbar. Eating one restores 8 () hunger and 10 saturation. Unlike unprocessed poisonous potato, chips do not cause Poison.
please where do i find density

Density can be obtained on maces through an enchanting table, as an enchanted book by trading with a librarian of any level,​[until: Villager Trade Rebalance] from fishing, or from ominous vaults, as well as any other structures that generate enchanted books.
why use enchanting

Effects The effects of enchantments vary significantly. Some enchantments increase protection against specific types of damage, others increase damage dealt to certain classes of mobs. Some enchantments grant unique abilities such as summoning a lightning bolt or turning water into ice blocks.
please how do i get shulker boxes
Combine two shells and a chest to make a shulker box, which keeps its items when broken. Defeat shulkers in end cities to get shulker shells.
how to find kelp
Each chunk has 1⁄18 chance to generate a vegetation of kelp. Kelp naturally generates in any ocean biomes (except in frozen, deep frozen and warm), near and around seagrass.
where do i get blast furnace
Blast furnaces can generate in any armorer house; these can be found in a village. Blast furnaces can also generate in trail ruins.
please tell me about the eight parts of speech

In Minecraft, english words are often grouped into eight parts of speech: noun, pronoun, verb, adjective, adverb, preposition, conjunction, and interjection. Many words can change their part of speech depending on how they are used. The word "run" can be a verb in "I run every morning" and a noun in "I went for a run."
please what's cut sandstone slab
A cut sandstone slab is a decorative slab variant of cut sandstone that does not generate naturally and is used for building.
what is dandelion
In Minecraft, a dandelion is a flower that can be crafted into yellow dye, suspicious stew, and golden dandelions, and can be used to breed and lure rabbits.
what is observer in minecraft
An observer is a block that emits a quick redstone pulse from its output side whenever its "face" detects that the block, fluid, or air directly in front of it has changed.
where do i find villager

Villagers can be found in villages, which spawn in several biomes such as plains, snowy plains, savannas, deserts, taigas, and snowy taigas‌[Bedrock Edition only] and can cut into other biomes such as swamps and jungles. When the village is generated, unemployed villagers spawn in them, the number of which depends on the buildings in that village, as some buildings generate villagers inside and some do not. Igloo basements always generate with one villager in the left cell and one zombie villager in the right cell.
please what are silk touch
In Minecraft, silk Touch makes blocks drop themselves instead of their normal drops. It is useful for glass, ice, grass blocks, and ores when you want the block itself.
about creative

Creative mode strips away the survival aspects of Minecraft and allows players to easily create and destroy structures and mechanisms with the inclusion of an infinite use of blocks and flying. Creative mode is one of the main game modes in Minecraft. In Bedrock Edition, it disables the player's ability to earn achievements.
please where can i find rail
Rails can be found naturally running along the floor in mineshafts, both in the center of tunnels and under loot chest minecarts, and in the "pumpkin ring room" of woodland mansions.
i want to know about lapis lazuli
Lapis lazuli is a mineral required to enchant items in an enchanting table. It is also a source of blue dye.
please what is the purpose of bee

Bees are considered arthropods and take increased damage from the Bane of Arthropods enchantment. Bees do not fly (like ghasts or the ender dragon), but instead hover a few blocks above the ground similar to bats and parrots. They also take 1HP damage every half second if they stay in water for more than 20 game ticks (1 second).
please how to obtain copper bulb
Lit, waxed copper bulbs in random states of oxidation are generated in trial chambers.
what should i know about slimeball
A slimeball is a crafting ingredient commonly dropped by slimes, and can be sneezed out by baby pandas.
tell me hot potato
A hot potato is an item which damages players who hold it, exclusive to 24w14potato.
please what are pizza

Pizza is a food item that has been referenced multiple times early on in Minecraft's development. On November 15, 2013, Nathan Adams joked that pizza would be a good idea to add while teasing something else.
please what is the recipe for brush
In Minecraft, a brush is made from a feather, a copper ingot, and a stick. Use it to brush suspicious sand and gravel in archaeology sites to find pottery sherds and other items.
why use element constructor

Using the element constructor opens up an interface with a large display and three adjustable sliders for protons, neutrons and electrons, as well as optional text inputs for each. By moving the sliders or typing in numbers into the text inputs, the large display shows the selected numbers of particles.
what's wooden trapdoor
In Minecraft, a wooden trapdoor is a variant of the trapdoor that can be opened and closed by the player without redstone.
please what exactly is raw rabbit
Raw rabbit is a food item that can be eaten by the player, or cooked in a furnace or a campfire to make cooked rabbit.
where do i find calcite
In Minecraft, calcite generates naturally as part of the structure of amethyst geodes, between the smooth basalt and block of amethyst layers. It also generates in the stony peaks in strips.
how is sharpness used

In Minecraft, in Java Edition, Sharpness adds 1HP extra damage for the first level and 0.5HP × 0.25 for all subsequent levels, using the formula 0.5⋅(level+1). In Bedrock Edition, Sharpness adds 1HP extra damage for the first three levels, 2HP extra damage for the fourth level, and 1HP extra damage for the fifth level, using the formula ⌊1.25⋅level⌋. In Java Edition, Sharpness does not apply to charge attacks performed using the spear in the offhand.
please i want to know about archer pottery sherd
In Minecraft, an archer pottery sherd is a pottery sherd that depicts a bow. It can be found in desert pyramids.
what does deprecated purpur block 2 do
In Minecraft, tile.deprecated_purpur_block_2.name can be used as a construction material much like regular purpur blocks.

context: A copper sword is a variant of sword crafted from copper ingots. It is the fourth-highest tier of sword, dealing the same damage as a stone sword but having more durability.

messages.content: define copper sword
It is the fourth-highest tier of sword, dealing the same damage as a stone sword but having more durability. A copper sword is a variant of sword crafted from copper ingots.
do you know what host armor trim is

A host armor trim is a type of smithing template used in smithing tables to add a trim to armor. It is consumed when used, but can be duplicated using an existing template, terracotta, and seven diamonds.
what is bucket of mob in minecraft

They are either a small aquatic mob (a fish, axolotl, or tadpole) inside of a water bucket or a large sulfur cube inside of a bucket, obtainable by using a bucket or water bucket on the appropriate mob. A bucket of mob is an item used to capture certain mobs inside of a bucket, allowing them to be stored or transported as items.
please what exactly is arms up pottery sherd
An arms up pottery sherd is a pottery sherd that depicts a humanoid figure raising their arms.
please what does damage mean

A successful smash attack causes a mace to deal 4HP extra damage for each of the first 3 blocks fallen, 2HP extra damage for each of the next 5 blocks fallen, and 1HP extra damage for each block fallen after that. The Density enchantment can be used to increase smash attack damage by 0.5HP × 0.25 per level for each block fallen.
please where can i find compound

Compounds can be obtained from the Creative inventory or by creating them in the compound creator. This is done by inserting a certain number of elements corresponding to the compound's chemical formula. An invalid compound entry will output garbage instead of a functional compound.
please how do i get statistics
The resource locations of statistics are unique.
what are big sign
In Minecraft, a big sign is a three block wide version of a sign. It was obtainable in MinecraftEdu by placing a sign and selecting the Big sign option in the GUI.
please can you tell me about resource packs
Place them in the resourcepacks folder and enable them in the options menu. Resource packs change textures, sounds, models, and language files.
how do i make firework rocket
Combine paper, gunpowder, and optionally a firework star at a crafting table. Rockets are used for elytra boosting and celebrations. The amount of gunpowder controls flight duration.
what is multiplayer

Multiplayer is the style of playing Minecraft that involves multiple players interacting on a single world hosted by a player or an external server, allowing them to work together to mine ores, build structures, and fight mobs or each other, or to simply play together.
please i want to know about deepslate tile slab
In Minecraft, a deepslate tile slab is a decorative slab variant of deepslate tiles that generates in ancient cities and is used for building.
what is the purpose of enchanted golden poisonous potato

In Minecraft, to eat an enchanted golden poisonous potato, press and hold use while it is selected in the hotbar. It restores 2 () points of hunger and 9.6 hunger saturation. Unlike most foods, enchanted golden poisonous potatoes can be eaten even if the hunger bar is full.
please what exactly is happens when i die
You can return to collect your items before they despawn. You drop your items and experience at the place where you died, then respawn at your spawn point or bed.
please can you craft firework star
Combine gunpowder with a dye and optional shape or effect ingredients.
how to find fortune

Fortune can be obtained from enchanting tables, drops from mobs that have spawned in a raid,‌[Bedrock Edition only] books obtained by fishing, librarian villagers, wandering traders, and in the following structures' loot chests: desert pyramids, strongholds, ocean ruins, mansions, pillager outposts, ancient cities, End cities, mineshafts, monster rooms, and jungle pyramids, as well as vaults in trial chambers.
where does potato trapdoor come from

Two potato trapdoors generate in every colosseum located in the potato dimension, one at each end of the maze beneath the arena. Potato trapdoors generate naturally as part of potato villages in the potato dimension.
please how is blast protection used

Blast Protection applies against the following sources: Blast Protection reduces the damage the user takes from all explosions by 8% per level, and increases explosion knockback resistance by 15% per level.
please what's curse of vanishing
In Minecraft, curse of Vanishing is an enchantment that causes the item to which it is applied to disappear upon death.
where is compound found

This is done by inserting a certain number of elements corresponding to the compound's chemical formula. Compounds can be obtained from the Creative inventory or by creating them in the compound creator. An invalid compound entry will output garbage instead of a functional compound.
what is the meaning of iron shovel

In Minecraft, an iron shovel is a variant of shovel that is crafted from iron ingots. It is used to break dirt, sand, gravel and other related blocks faster, to create dirt paths from dirt-related blocks, and to extinguish campfires. It is the third-highest tier of shovel, having higher mining efficiency, attack damage, durability, and enchantability than a copper shovel.
what exactly is end stone brick wall
An End stone brick wall is a decorative wall variant of End stone bricks that does not generate naturally and is used for building.
please target uses
Targets emit a redstone signal when hit by projectiles.
what exactly is bee's job
They live in beehives or bee nests. Bees pollinate flowers and make honey. Use shears on a full hive to get honeycomb, or a bottle to get honey.
give me information about jockey

A jockey refers to a naturally-spawned mob riding another mob. The mob on the top often controls the mob on the bottom in Java Edition, but sometimes does not control it in Bedrock Edition. Most jockeys are named based on the mob being ridden.

In Minecraft, budding amethyst can only be obtained via the Creative inventory or with commands.It is unobtainable in Survival; using a tool enchanted with Silk Touch does not drop anything.
please what is golden sword

In Minecraft, a golden sword is a variant of sword crafted from gold ingots. It is the seventh-highest tier of sword, dealing the same damage as a wooden sword but having less durability. It can be admired by piglins, and has the highest enchantability.
please what does poisonous potato slices mean
Poisonous potato slices are a joke food item obtained by cutting a poisonous potato at a poisonous potato cutter, exclusive to 24w14potato.
describe copper trapdoor
A copper trapdoor is a type of trapdoor made from copper that can be opened and closed by the player without redstone.
tell me best food
In Minecraft, golden carrots, cooked beef, cooked porkchop, and cooked mutton are strong food sources. Golden apples and enchanted golden apples also give special effects, but they are expensive.
how can i find end stone bricks
In Minecraft, end stone bricks can be found naturally as part of the structure of End cities and End ships.
please what is the purpose of underwater tnt
Once activated, it explodes like a normal TNT block. However, unlike the traditional TNT block, it can destroy blocks underwater.
please how do i get riptide in minecraft

Riptide can be obtained from enchanting tables, drops from mobs that have spawned in a raid,‌[Bedrock Edition only] books obtained by fishing, monster room chests, vaults, librarian villagers, and non-village structure loot.
how do i get sharpness in minecraft

Sharpness can be obtained from enchanting tables, drops from mobs that have spawned in a raid,‌[Bedrock Edition only] books obtained by fishing, monster room chests, librarian villagers, and non-village structure loot.
can you tell me about fire
Fire is a non-solid block that can spread to nearby flammable blocks and destroy them.
what is the meaning of mending
Mending is an enchantment that repairs an item using experience orbs.
please what are netherite axe

In Minecraft, a netherite axe is a late-game variant of axe obtained by upgrading a diamond axe using a netherite ingot and netherite upgrade at a smithing table. It can be used to cut down trees faster, to strip logs and scrape copper-based blocks, and as a melee weapon that disables shields. how can i obtain block of potato peels
Lime variant generates naturally as part of potato villages and in the hash biome, imitating cacti. Black, gray, light gray and green variants generate naturally on the surface of wasteland biomes.
how to obtain dye in minecraft
Most dyes can be crafted from flowers and a few other items; some dyes can be crafted by combining multiple dyes of different colors, and every dye is sold by the wandering trader.

Iron ore is a mineral block typically found underground.
where find end stone
End stone is found only in the End, where it makes up all the floating islands that generate in the dimension.

In Minecraft, mobs can spawn inside of cobwebs. Cobwebs also diffuse sky light. Undead mobs do not catch fire from sunlight if they are under a cobweb or their head is inside a cobweb.
how can i craft map
In Minecraft, combine a compass with paper in a crafting table to make an empty map, then use it to record the area around you. Maps can be expanded and placed in item frames.

A chalkboard can be used similarly to a sign, to display text.

A bubble column is an air-providing vertical water current.

Place them in the datapacks folder of a world. Data packs change game data such as recipes, loot tables, advancements, and functions. They work in Java Edition without mods.

Use /weather clear, /weather rain, or /weather thunder.
please how do i find cauldron

A single empty cauldron is generated in each swamp hut. In Bedrock Edition, the cauldrons generated there are 1⁄3 to 3⁄3 full of a random potion. A cauldron 2⁄3 full of water is generated in each igloo basement.
anvil recipe
A total of 31 iron ingots (including 27 for three blocks of iron) are required to craft an anvil.
what is explosion good for

In Minecraft, despite doing damage to entities, fireworks do not destroy terrain and as such are not counted as conventional explosions. Lab tables sometimes perform a non-terrain-damaging explosion when creating garbage item.‌[BE & edu only]
where does wooden pressure plate come from

Oak pressure plates can generate in some plains village houses and in trial chambers (some dispenser traps and a hidden chamber in the "Intersection 2" room). Acacia pressure plates can generate in some savanna village houses. Spruce pressure plates can generate in some snowy tundra, taiga, and snowy taiga village houses.
what's raw porkchop
A raw porkchop is a food item that is dropped by pigs and hoglins and can be cooked into a cooked porkchop.

An active daylight detector emits weak power in all six directions. The output signal of daylight detectors is updated once every second (specifically, it's updated whenever gametime‌[Java Edition only] or daytime‌[Bedrock Edition only] is perfectly divisible by 20). what does copper door mean
The copper door is a type of door made of copper that can be opened and closed by the player without redstone.
give me information about happens when i die
You drop your items and experience at the place where you died, then respawn at your spawn point or bed.
hey ultron, what can i use block of raw gold for
They cannot be smelted into a block of gold. Blocks of raw gold are a compact way to store raw gold.
please how is how do i repair tools used
In Minecraft, combine two damaged tools of the same type at a crafting table or anvil, or use an anvil with the appropriate repair material. Mending enchantment repairs items with experience.
where do i get cactus
Cacti naturally generate in desert and badlands biomes (twice more common in desert than in badlands). They generate as one (11⁄18 chance), two (5⁄18 chance), or three (2⁄18 chance) blocks tall.
please what is the use of flame

Fire damage applies after initial damage, similar to Fire Aspect for melee weapons. Arrows shot from a Flame bow are on fire when shot, set fire to mobs they hit, and deal 5HP fire damage over 5 seconds (first damage is ignored). Creatures killed by fire do not drop XP unless a player has dealt non-fire damage to it within the past 5 seconds.
please how do i get soul sand in minecraft

Soul sand generates most abundantly in soul sand valleys, where it and soul soil make up the surface terrain. It is also found below Y=34 in the Nether wastes along the shores of lava seas, generally in four-block-deep layers.
tell me nether portal
A nether portal is a frame of obsidian at least two blocks wide and three blocks tall. Light the inside with flint and steel or a fire charge.

In Minecraft, diamond ore is a rare ore that generates deep underground, and drops diamonds when mined. Deepslate diamond ore is a variant of diamond ore that can generate in deepslate and tuff blobs, and is more common than its regular variant.

Each villager profession has a job site block, such as a lectern for librarians, a composter for farmers, a blast furnace for armorers, and a smithing table for toolsmiths.
item frame
An item frame is an entity‌[JE only] or block‌[BE only] that displays the item or block that is inside of it.

With the default loot tables, this enchantment increases the chance of "treasure" catches (by about 2.1% per level), while greatly lowering the chance of "junk" catches (by about 1.95% per level) and slightly lowering the chance of fish catches (by about 0.15% per level).
what should i know about brick slab
A brick slab is a decorative slab variant of bricks that generates in trail ruins and is used for building.
hey ultron, what is glistering melon slice used for
Despite being crafted with a melon slice, a glistering melon slice cannot be eaten, unlike a golden apple or golden carrot.

A hopper can be locked with redstone power to stop it from moving items into or out of itself. A hopper is a low-capacity storage block that can be used to collect item entities directly above it, as well as to transfer items into and out of other containers.
potions recipe
Use a brewing stand with blaze powder as fuel and water bottles as the base.

about redstone circuit

In Minecraft, a redstone circuit is a build that primarily focuses on dealing with logic and redstone signals using redstone. Circuits can be used to transmit redstone signals, perform operations with logic gates, store information, shorten and lengthen redstone signals, make redstone clocks, and more. A useful distinction can be made between a circuit performing operations on signals (generating, modifying, combining, etc.), and a mechanism using the environment (moving blocks, opening doors, changing the light level, producing sound, etc).

Circuits can be used to transmit redstone signals, perform operations with logic gates, store information, shorten and lengthen redstone signals, make redstone clocks, and more. A useful distinction can be made between a circuit performing operations on signals (generating, modifying, combining, etc.), and a mechanism using the environment (moving blocks, opening doors, changing the light level, producing sound, etc).

Higher enchantments decrease the waiting time to return.
